description: The 'dss_plugins_live' dataset provides comprehensive information about various plugins used within a data science platform. Each entry in the dataset represents a plugin, detailing its unique identifier, label, code environment, version, and author. The dataset also includes descriptive information about the plugin's functionality, associated tags, and the projects in which the plugin is utilized. Additionally, it indicates whether the plugin is in development, its total usage count, and if it is a built-in feature of the platform. This dataset is particularly useful for developers and data scientists who need to manage and track plugin usage, development status, and integration within projects. It can help in identifying popular plugins, understanding their application in different projects, and managing plugin updates or deprecations. The inclusion of URLs for each plugin allows for easy access to more detailed documentation or summaries, enhancing the dataset's utility for quick reference and decision-making.
shortDesc: Dataset of live plugins with details on usage and development.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each plugin, key for tracking.

columns.name: label
columns.comment: Human-readable name of the plugin, aids recognition.

columns.name: code_env_name
columns.comment: Name of the code environment associated with the plugin.

columns.name: version
columns.comment: Current version of the plugin, important for updates.

columns.name: author
columns.comment: Creator or maintainer of the plugin, indicates responsibility.

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: Keywords associated with the plugin, useful for categorization.

columns.name: description
columns.comment: Detailed explanation of the plugin's functionality.

columns.name: plugin_used_in_projectkeys
columns.comment: List of project keys where the plugin is used.

columns.name: isDev
columns.comment: Indicates if the plugin is in development, boolean value.

columns.name: total_usages
columns.comment: Number of times the plugin has been used, usage metric.

columns.name: is_built_in_plugin
columns.comment: Indicates if the plugin is built-in, boolean value.

columns.name: url
columns.comment: Web link to the plugin's summary or documentation.
